txt: *And* your leg still hurts from the tribunal.
*Hyyyngh!* It makes your brain swell just to think about...
*Not* familiar in a good way, you might say. There's pain in there somewhere...
A bitter cringe. It *hurts*. You look to the lieutenant...
A bitter cringe. It hurts her.
A cornered animal might seek a hiding place that has some sentimental value.
A dull pain flashes through your mind.
A flash of pain interrupts you, making you grimace instead of spewing out the words.
A flash of pain interrupts you, making you wince instead of letting the words out.
A flash of pain interrupts your thought, making you grimace.
A flash of pain, like slamming your fist against iron. He is stronger than he looks -- and he looks like Ramout Karzai.
A great and terrible spike. The blood freezes in her veins.
A great pain moves through her, a dark and indefinite wave. She continues in spite of it.
A little pain there. A prick.
A pain burns in your chest, radiating. A crown of arteries on fire.
A quick grimace of pain passes over René's features, but he immediately regains control. His face now a dispassionate mask again.
A sharp pain shoots up your side and into your stomach. You must not look too good. Luckily it passes...
A small agony -- minuscule bones may have fractured -- but it proves the point.
A symmetric burn on his neck, resembling the letters *Los Los*. Has he tried to burn it off, leave that life behind?
A twinge at the back of your head makes you flinch. Your eye starts twitching.
Agonizing pain...
Almost snapped your neck... but I fucking got this. No pain... no pain...
Also, it's just close enough to endure the walk.
Also, you should say: I need to kill myself and it's all over!
And gets over it in two seconds? Seems like it didn't really hurt him.
And more beautiful, and *more* beautiful...
And then he lost. So did they all.
And there's a lot of it. Ever present in your organs. It's like every one of them has their own *nasty* song to sing.
Another flash of pain. Again you swallow it, but this time, some of it does not stay down. You think you taste it in your mouth. So does the insect, twitching suddenly...
As she says the word "officer," you feel a spike in the agony. It sounds like the entire radio frequency range is screaming directly into your neural pathways.
As you focus on the overwhelming mass of colourful novels, a discrepancy catches your eye -- one of the books is not like the others.
At least it clearly wasn't Dolores Dei. She wouldn't be *false*. She's beautiful.
Baby, you know it's going to hurt.
Because it *stings*. In an ancient and beautiful way.
Below it all the bass grows, like the jaws of a giant compressor gnawing on metal and wood. It does not sound benevolent *at all*.
Bent metal, broken glass... your path lies strewn with the broken forms of everyday objects...
Betrayal is not painless. Even a doubt of it hurts.
Brace yourself!
Bullets have bitten little pieces out of him. It must have been excruciating, especially the hip... Before you is a temple of pain that knew little tenderness in life.
CONDITION BLACK, ALL SYSTEMS CRITICAL!
Change of topic!
Cuno *feels* it; this was no light tap.
Damn, that's cold.
Desperation is gearing up.
Did someone say *shooting yourself in the foot*?
Doesn't wish to hurt you? Not according to your ear canals... wait, no, not even your ear canals -- this is going directly into your neural pathways.
Dolores Dei! Dolores...
Dolores Dei!
Dolores Dei... so, *so* beautiful.
Dolores...
Don't say it. You're not a degenerate alcoholic, you're a cop and a hero.
Don't take it personally. There just wasn't any *juice* left in your carton, pal.
Don't worry. It'll get better when you die.
Don't. There's this *itch* in the middle of your skull, where you've never reached. Never scratched...
Dora...
Even better if you can find someone else, preferably a large man dressed in nothing but a towel, to thrash you while you're spread naked and helpless on a cool slab.
Even under the increased force on your skull there is no pain... just the sound of your own blood gushing in there, feeding your mind with oxygen.
Even worse, a love aborted and smothered, stamped beneath his brilliant boot heel.
Far enough not to hurt for a while.
Feeling nausea? Vomiting? Tenderness or pain around the liver area? Tiny red lines on the skin above waist level? More like *days*, Coppo. The clock is ticking, your liver tells you so.
Feels *good* though, doesn't it? The sting.
Feels good for some reason.

Feels like someone set a mustard field ablaze right inside your nose, then drenched it in tear gas. Your nose is a singular source of pain... but at the same time you don't remember the last time you felt so alive.
Feels slick and warm with blood. The pain is too strong to know what has happened there. Even clutching to your consciousness takes everything you got.
Finally the pressure recedes. You find yourself covered in cold sweat. Try not to move too fast -- maybe that will keep you from collapsing.
Finally the stabbing recedes. You could try doing it again to see how painful it gets. (Very.) But do you really want to risk it?
Fine. Keep up the charade another day. This could have been so liberating, but you cling to the case, to your partner, to the world... it's pitiful.
For quite a long time.
For you, she is something painful, though it's hard to say why.
Fuck it, it doesn't hurt.
Fuck it. Do it. It can't be worse than what you've already felt.
Get ready for a world of pain, man.
God dammit. Why are you so stupid? That's it -- we're aborting this mental failure. Back to questions.
Good stuff. You fucking *loved* this.
He doesn't know whether to expunge or consume. What will pacify the wrenching feeling in his gut?
He's taking it for mental and emotional, not physical pain these days.
Here it comes.
Hey, you already practically sacrificed a limb when you got shot in the tribunal... it's nothing major!
Him.
His half-open eyes give him the look of a dead man. But he is in there... and not enjoying himself.
His wife left him. He needs to kill himself -- make her sorry she did.
I don't even have to say it anymore.
I wouldn't be so sure, Tommy.
I'm sorry this didn't do anything... usually hurting yourself does something for you.
I'm sorry this didn't do anything... usually hurting yourself does.
If you wear those pieces, it will help me protect your mortal coil.
Is that blood on the ground before you? Are your ears *bleeding*?
It *is* tearing you up. It's like there's a tiny hateful beast shredding your very soul...
It burns like acid.
It doesn't hurt, yet. The rush of endorphins will keep the pain at bay for a while yet.
It hurts, but keep your cool. You've got this.
It looks better on him because he isn't in as much *pain* while producing it as you are now. Although there's already a hint of that pain, certainly.
It would take a million years of evolution -- or a total reversal in the condition of the world -- for your pain to end.
It's especially bad suddenly. Felt like a vein exploded.
It's getting really painful for him, thinking about the body still being out there for people to see and children to desecrate.
It's just a little hangover-induced photosensitivity. Don't over-react.
It's like ripping off a bandage. The least painful way is to do it straight away, without stalling.
It's not as bad as it feels. You've maybe pulled a joint; the indignity makes it worse.
It's nothing. You're alive, that's what matters.
It's painful to even think about.
It's too much! Your ear drums are throbbing, about to burst!
It's worse this time. Maybe you should stop trying to catch the tie?
Judging by the creases on your forehead and the lines on your cheeks -- too much more. Going back years, decades even....
Kudos.
Like a diving suit powered by pain.
Like an amputated limb in the sand.
Like parting from a loved one.
Like you don't have enough on your plate! You feel a sudden surge of self-pity coming on...
Little black spots dance on your retinas. It's almost pleasurable.
Look at him. Life hasn't been easy on him. You wanna drag him along and put him through more shit? *Your* shit?
Look! There's a discarded milk carton on the floor. Why don't you destroy that, too?
Lowball her. The wretched are used to rolling with the punches.
Man up! It's nothing. Pick the goddamn key up, put it in your pocket, and move on.
Momentarily the sounds are swept away. Pain shoots up your right foot and into your groin...
Must be hard to force your face to move in a new fashion. If you continue like this, you'll have an aneurysm. Then you'll have to, too.
Nice try. The tears come streaming down your face as you crumble to the ground.
No -- your resilience.
No, buddy, that's not going to help. You can't shield yourself from this -- it's an entirely *new* type of experience. Way worse than all the previous ones.
No, no. It was her mostly. Don't lie to him, necktie.
No, not that one.
No, you don't. You can keep it in. You can keep *anything* in.
No. Stop thinking it. I said it wasn't her. She was true.
No. This has to end. Do the last one.
No. We're not gonna do this. Your hand is *not* going to cramp up, not now.
No. You'd remember that. You've been shot at four times. Hit twice.
No... not gun. Something repressed and painful. Too late. The moment has passed.
Not again... take the pain, god damn it, at least take that!
Not that it will keep you warm at night. Brrr.
Not true. Her beauty was like the glowing coil on a hot stove, and yet you felt *blessed* to touch it...
Nothing of interest. Only silence and the cosmic background pain-radiation.
Oh yes. It would be so sweet to taste the barrel once more. That sour metal...  Oh, but not yet. But stick with it -- keep going dark, and it'll finally *click*.
Oh yes. It would be so sweet to taste the barrel once more. That sour metal...  maybe there *is* a way? Not yet. But stick with it -- keep going dark, and it'll finally *click*.
Oh, whatever. This barely registers as damage.
Okay. It wasn't Dolores Dei. She's not false.
One bullet should do the trick. You have the gun... and you have the bullet.
Ooh, that's the good stuff. THE MOTIVE! There you go, see, this works. DO THE MOTIVE. The pain has dislodged something in your soaked sponge of a brain...
Ouch, ouch... The kid turns double for a second. Damn, that hurts. Breathe...
Ouch, you strained your elbow trying to catch that stupid thing... dammit.
Ouch...
Ow, shoot! Whose moronic idea was it to just *run through the door*? Don't you know that things like that *hurt*?!
Pain Welkin.
Pain radiates through your leg. It still hurts to use it -- even for kicking snow into someone's face.
Points are good. Have one, you old dog! Before we all die...
Punch it again, the pain is good.
Ready for the damage. She knows you're grilling her.
Ringing by the bedside of a dark but capacious apartment with long windows... you know this to be true.
Seems like he's not actually that interested in hearing the details. Too bad, you had a good story cooked up...
Sharp pain shoots through your hip, throbbing...
She's in pain. She's in so much pain and so are you, your chest is burning.
She's like 14! You're humiliated in front of a minor, what's *wrong* with you, son?!
She's pointing it *quite* hard in there. Feels like a knife.
Shouldn't have brought him into this. He doesn't know pain like you do.
Slap yourself in your head again, jump start it!
Slap yourself in your head, jump start it!
So much pain. Back pain, neck pain, headaches, carpal tunnel, chest pain... no gym membership can make up for working in this manner.
So you volunteered, sometime in the past? For the beatdown and the hail of bullets? So very you...
Some of your more *old-school* social views. Your love of retro music.
Someone thought this was a romance story, but it's actually a thoroughly excruciating work of psychological realism.
Sometimes when things get very bad it's good to remind yourself that you have a body. By scratching it.
Sort of. But by god does it *burn* in your chest...
Sounds like you were in some real *fundamental* pain there, muscle-man.
Sounds like you're a potential Suicide Cop! With his finger on the *eject* button. Ready to let go of this life! Guess what?
Sounds like you're the Suicide Cop! With his finger on the *eject* button. Ready to let go of this life! But guess what?
Stay with me, the biting is having *some* kind of effect, the pain is receding...
Still bad. Definitely worse than the last time.
Still happening.
Still ongoing. Now is a good time to start worrying.
Stop thinking about your lost gun, dammit. You'll get a heart attack.
Strange... there are no memories of that recorded anywhere in your body. He's making it up.
Suddenly -- another flash of pain. Worse than the one before. The taste of blood in your mouth. The insect tastes it too, twitching suddenly...
Take the pain, god damn it, at least take that!
Test your limits. Surpass them. Dance till you drop. Dance till you die, if you must.
That concussion must be making him dizzy.
That guy is a fraud.
That hurt. The man knows where to sting.
That room was so small. To be stuck in there with him... not an easy fight for a kid.
That voice should be registered as a sonic weapon, cause the damage it does to your head is *very* real.
That voice... so warm and sweet...
That would be the sweet endorphin rush. You've granted him a natural high, at least until the hurt sets in.
That's a pathetic-looking *bull*. Where are the sharpened horns ready to puncture your gristle? There's no real danger here.
That's an awful decision. Why would you not want to shield yourself from it? It's an entirely *new* type of experience -- way worse than all the previous ones.
That's because they're all a bunch of squares who like to sit around with their fingers up each other's assholes.
That's it. You're caught in a trap. It'll take quite a while for the shit-circus to end now.
The beating he took must be more serious than he lets on.
The chair is *incredibly* uncomfortable. Fortunately, your ass is made of *iron* and the chair is made of wood. Iron beats wood. You manage not to shift around too much...
The chair you're sitting on has got to be the most uncomfortable chair in the world. It's *violating* your backside.
The door shudders with your impact. Hinges snap, panels crack, splinters fly by as you smash through, tumbling into the darkness ahead.
The girl is cold all of a sudden. Very cold.
The lameness is causing her physical pain. The damage may be permanent.
The more it hurts, the more you have to have it.
The pain flows over your entire body like an awful shock. A grim knowing rises from within -- half of your body must be gone.
The pain intensifies as your hands attempt to reach out into the pale chaos.
The pain is barely noticeable under the adrenaline rush.
The pain is becoming unbearable now.
The pain is too immense to scream. It pushes the air out of your lungs. Everything goes dark, a distant blur as you recede into it...
The pain is true. He's seen the kids do worse than that.
The pain it was causing her.
The pain of the word recedes, he's feeling better now. Further away from *education*.
The pain written in the creases of his face... sheesh! This is a man who's been trying to catch falling knives for *years*.
The pain, it is nothing! Revel in it! Absorb it! Gain power from it!
The prospect of the Cuno turning lame is physically painful for her.

The sight of the insect pulses with pain, as a streak of fire tries to shoot up your leg. You swallow it. Unmoved. Not now. There's blood dripping... warm.  The creature must feel it too, it twitches.
The spread pattern of these bullet holes makes your chest ache. Your breath grows heavier.
The tears bring some relief, but not much.
The violent white noise becomes even more overwhelming closer to the Compressor. Feels like your brain is swelling up in your skull.
The visions compete for space in your brain with the hailstorm of radio signals coming from the compressor. You feel like your skull is about to shatter into smithereens.
The words still echo in the hallway...
There is no coming back from this one. It will stay with you -- in nightmares.
There's just this *itch*, deep under your skull, where you've never reached. Never scratched...
There's no way he could manage the pain without them. It's safe to say he is addicted to painkillers by now.
There's pain in there, if you want some. That much you know.
There's real anguish in his voice. A drunken sadness suddenly engulfs him. Memories...
There's tenderness in the carabineer's look. Tenderness that's curdled into pain or something darker.
There. It's going to be easier to reach the machine now.
These formulas look oddly *painful*. Maybe it's the hangover, but they give you a headache.
These words hit you *right* where it hurts.
This guy clearly gets off on macabre stories. You've got just the one -- an absolute skullfuckery.
This guy is suffering from clinical depression. And it's been going on awhile.
This is bad. Feels like sharp stones grinding in your chest and keeping you from moving.
This is not a *real* heart attack. This is a joke. It's probably just your lungs or your oesophagus. The oesophagus does practically nothing.
This is where a lesser man would stop to think about the pain shooting up his right leg and into his groin -- not you, you're concentrated on how...
This isn't a real heart attack. You should probably just exercise more.
This kind of stuff would hurt -- if not for you not caring about little things like that.
This only made it harder. Here comes the pain.
This... is a bit *much* for me. It feels like your ribs are cracking around your heart.
War isn't tied with regret for him. Nevermind, the moment is gone.
We've been here before. You've got this.
Wearing out. Nearly gone. Sometimes he forgets to keep the pen on the paper as he moves his hand and the lines vanish from underneath...
Well, it doesn't *feel* much better, but you can form sentences now. Thinking doesn't seem to hurt as much.

What more is there in any of us? You think, as the sight of the insect fades and pain shoots up your right foot and into your abdomen, darkening your view... when it returns the insect twitches, feeling the blood on you...
While it was actually her...
With some strange emotion. This is about to get really graphic. Last moment to back off.
With your back against the cold mosaic floor you feel the pain recede. You just need to get up and dust yourself off...
Written in a rush. In pain. A race to beat your own heart's pulse to some dark finish line.
Yeah, a painkiller would be good about now. This thing is *pulsating* with discomfort.
Yeah, that kid's taken a beating -- or ten -- from his dad. He has regard for a man who can walk after taking some damage.
Yeah. Put a stake through your heart. She'll get hurt too -- collateral damage.
Yeah... Because falling from that height seems, well -- SPLAT! So don't do that. Just, you know...
Yes, but it itches really, really bad...
Yes, your pain is real. The pain of a tree is mute and base and uninteresting.
Yes. Beat yourself up for it. Good. Everyone must suffer. You, the tree, everyone.
Yes. Bullets will fly, they always do. And the coil is fleshy and mush and permeable. Cast it in ceramic shell. Resist death.
Yes. You're a total fucking horror show.
You are *The Destroyer*, the bane of inanimate matter.
You can barely hear him, the pain is so bad.
You can take it. Just breathe in slowly.
You can take it. Just breathe.
You can take it. Just don't lean on that leg of yours too heavily.
You can take it. Just don't lean on the old leg too heavily.
You can take this one too. Just breathe in slowly.
You can take this! Blossom like a pain-flower.
You can take this. It's not nearly as bad as the last time.
You can't, the sensation won't go away. It only gets worse...
You did it. The Compressor lies broken on its side. It's quiet in your head again. It still hurts like hell, but...
You feel something -- like a swarm of hornets buzzing under your scalp. A strange tingling you can almost *smell*.
You focus on the overwhelming mass of colourful novels to find anything of note, but it only ends up with your eyes aching from the strain.
You force the rest of the sentence out through pain, thick as molasses, no longer able to hear yourself speak.
You force the rest of the sentence out through pain, thick as molasses, without really hearing it.
You got hit. The armour took most of it, but still your rib cage burns. Feels like blood is slowly seeping into your lungs...
You idiot! You don't have a gun or any bullets!
You idiot! You don't have any bullets!
You idiot! You've got the bullet, but no gun!
You just do. And you know it is going to hurt.
You know the answer, don't think -- just say it!
You need to punch yourself again!
You peer into the faded marks in the stone... they peer back like an endless row of tiny black holes. Sweat starts trickling down your brow.
You push the rest of the thought through pain thick as molasses, without really concentrating on it.
You really went with it too. Really maximized the damage.
You should say: I need to kill myself and it's all over!
You smash into the wood and see a small crack appear on the door frame. It's going to take one more try to break through to the other side, but you've done it...
You sucked on a gun? Good. Good. Very normal.
You would be incinerated. Or worse.
You're holding it together, *somehow*, despite everything...
You're jabbing at the soft underbelly of his psyche. He realizes he's gotten defensive.
You're right, that's definitely not the behaviour of a destroyer at all. That's just severe anger-management problems and a disregard for property rights.
You.
Your aching leg doesn't want you to imagine *anything*, however. It just wants to lie down and rest.
Your angry voice carries through the Whirling, but you still can't stop the tears from welling up in your eyes...
Your body is taking a beating from the low frequencies crashing over you. It's making you feel... alive again.
Your chest feels tight, looking at them. It's closing in... caving in, ever tighter. Your breathing grows even heavier.
Your eyes burn with photosensitivity. It's not good.
Your fist bounces off the door and comes back to you on a wave of agony that surges up your arm.
Your hand cracks and twists in his grasp but your body is too numb with adrenaline to feel it...
Your hand is swelling up.
Your nerve endings tell you there is no such thing as a *positive* surprise.
Your toe has suffered damage. It hurts!
